summary: Apply risk registers, portfolio measures and scenario analysis to pension fund oversight. Explore the five-day course and practical outcomes.
lede: Pension fund risk management identifies and monitors investment, funding, liquidity and operational exposures so accountable people can act. For pension risk analysts, investment officers and scheme administrators, this intermediate course covers building risk registers, measuring portfolio indicators, setting limits and escalation triggers, and assessing scenarios and operational controls to support oversight and reporting.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who monitor pension assets, liabilities, controls or scheme operations and need to make risk evidence usable in oversight and reporting.
modules: Pension Risk Appetite and Investment Limits
Pension Scenario Analysis and Stress Testing
Pension Risk Dashboards and Oversight Reports
prerequisites: Prior experience in pension fund investment, administration, risk, compliance, actuarial work or audit is expected. Working familiarity with investment reports or pension scheme operations will help you complete the case exercises. Coding is not required; practical calculations use spreadsheet skills.
